ga_blocked_share.definition: Tile B meter length: blocklist entries (an ad vendor that the store's CMP listed as blocked and that had a configured sandboxed Shopify pixel, on the stores whose CMP wrote no 'marketing: yes') whose vendor sent an ad request from Shopify's sandbox before any choice, as a share of all such entries (k / n; Fig 4A top row). Drawn only; the printed numbers are k and n.
ga_blocked_share.check: k, n == fig4/derived_numbers.json fig4a_entries.counts (sandbox, n) and fig4a_kg.sandbox (k, n)

ga_race_share.definition: Tile C meter length: marketing pixel sandboxes that had started before the CMP's automatic 'marketing: no' write, as a share of all such sandboxes (k / n). Drawn only; the printed numbers are k and n.
ga_race_share.check: k == stats fig5.d.deny.pixels_before and n == stats fig5.d.deny.pixels
